title: Why more Calgary drivers choose mobile detailing
description: How mobile detailing works in Calgary, what you need to provide (nothing), and how it compares with a car wash or a drop-off detail shop.
excerpt: No drive to the shop, no waiting room, no hose or outlet needed. How mobile detailing works and how it compares with a car wash or a drop-off shop.

sections.heading: The time cost of a shop
paragraphs: A drop-off detail usually means two trips across town, a ride or a wait, and a car that's gone for most of the day. For a lot of people that's the real reason the detail never gets booked.

sections.heading: How mobile detailing works
paragraphs: We arrive at your home, office or storage lot with a self-contained van that carries its own water and power. You don't need to provide a hose or an outlet. The crew works where the vehicle is parked and walks it with you before leaving.

sections.heading: Mobile vs a car wash
paragraphs: An automatic wash is fast and cheap but uses the same brushes on every vehicle, which is where most swirl marks come from, and it doesn't touch the interior. A detail is hand work: decontamination, proper drying, interior extraction and protection.

sections.heading: Is the quality the same as a shop?
paragraphs: The equipment and products are the same professional lines a shop uses. What changes is where the work happens. In winter, heavier correction and coating work still needs a sheltered space, and we'll tell you when that applies.
